body_text: {"name":"Watershed Informatics","content":"\u003cp\u003eWatershed is searching for engineers for our Cambridge, MA office (remote until at least July 2021). The rate-limiting step to developing therapeutics diagnostics, and fundamental insights about human health and disease has transitioned from data generation to data analysis and interpretation. To tackle this problem, we create easy-to-use genomics data exploration tools for biologists to empower them to perform their own data analysis. We're composed of a single team that shares a monolithic code base, and we pride ourselves on our collaborative environment. We are looking for people who share our passion for science and technology, enjoy working in a fast-paced startup environment, desire to have their work impact the organization, and inspire growth in the people around them.\u003c/p\u003e"}
